About this page

  • This page publishes player names and DKP balances from the officers' approved ledger. That is public by design.
  • It never publishes BattleTags, Discord IDs or Discord names, class or spec, free-text notes, disciplinary findings, or who recorded, checked or approved a record.
  • The activity list shows DKP, loot, raid-week and roster records. history.json lists every record that is not private, setup and loot calls included, so event numbers here can skip.
  • Cap is the player's current DKP cap. Status shows confirmed membership: a dash and Unverified mean the player's guild rank has not been confirmed yet, and Not set means membership is not tracked yet.
  • To share a player or a record, copy the link from its # mark or its event number; it opens this page at that row. Only the newest records are listed here; older ones are in history.json.
  • No approved ledger has been published. Armory roster names do not imply a DKP balance.
